Booking QR Code Generator FAQ

Can I add my logo without covering the QR code?

Yes. Upload your logo for the sign. It sits outside the QR pattern so the design keeps a clear margin. Leave that margin intact if you place the PNG in another layout.

Will a printed code still work if my booking page moves?

The code keeps the URL you entered. Keep that address active or redirect it to your new booking page. If you cannot keep the old address, generate a fresh code before printing new signs.

Which file should I give my printer?

Download the PNG to place the code in a layout you already have. Use Print / save PDF to keep the headline, business name and optional logo together as a complete sign.

Can I link straight to a particular Shopify service?

Open the service as a customer and copy that public URL. Scan the result from a phone where you are signed out to make sure guests land on the intended service.

Does the QR code itself expire?

A static code continues to represent the same URL. Its usefulness depends on whether that destination remains available to customers.

How can I tell whether a window sign brings bookings?

Use a booking URL with your own campaign parameters before generating the code. Your existing analytics can then attribute visits if it records those parameters.
